SELECT TRADE_ID ,HAPPEN_DATE ,BOOK_DATE ,BOOKSET_DATE ,BOOKSET_ID ,BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM ( SELECT BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.rn ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.TRADE_ID ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.HAPPEN_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOKSET_DATE ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_ORDER ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOKSET_ID ,BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOK_DETAIL_ID FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 rownum, /* 虚拟列行标 */ IF(@TRADE_ID = tmp.TRADE_ID, @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1) AS rn, /* 分组虚拟列行标 */ @TRADE_ID := tmp.TRADE_ID /* 分组条件1 */ FROM ( /* 数据源 */ SELECT * FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT ORDER BY CAST(BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_ORDER as SIGNED) DESC ) tmp, /* 定义临时变量池 */ (SELECT @rownum := 0, @TRADE_ID := null, @rank := 0) a ) BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT cur.BOK_DETAIL_ID, todo.SEQ_NO, todo.BOOKSET_DATE, todo.BOOK_DATE, todo.HAPPEN_DATE, todo.TASK_ID FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT cur ON cur.BOOKSET_ID = todo.BOOKSET_ID AND cur.BOOKSET_DATE = todo.BOOKSET_DATE INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_NATURE_GROUP grp ON grp.GROUP_ID = 'XJL_KMCX' AND cur.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = grp.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE
) CASH ON BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOK_DETAIL_ID = CASH.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND CASH.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND CASH.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND CASH.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND CASH.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND CASH.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE 1 = 1 AND BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT.BOOK_DATE <= #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} ) TMP WHERE rn = 1 AND (BOOKSET_DATE != #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} OR BOOK_DATE != #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE}) ORDER BY BOOK_ORDER
